pages.title: Aria & Friends
pages.narrative: A Magical Tale of Fun & Friendship
pages.narrative2: Join Aria, Leo, and Felix on a whimsical journey!

pages.title: Act I: The Glade of Wonders
pages.narrative: The journey unfolds in the sunlit glade where cheerful friends gather!
pages.narrative2: Laughter, wonder, and curiosity waiting around every corner.

pages.title: Meet Leo!
pages.narrative: Once upon a sunny afternoon, Leo was full of cheerful ideas and ready to explore.
pages.narrative2: With a bright spark of imagination, Leo pointed towards the winding path ahead!

pages.title: Act II: The Whispering Woods
pages.narrative: Step into the next chapter as the trail enters the deep, enchanted forest!
pages.narrative2: Bold discoveries, friendly surprises, and hidden paths to uncover.

pages.title: Meet Felix!
pages.narrative: Felix joined in with curious gadgets and big smiles, ready for the adventure ahead.
pages.narrative2: Whirring gizmos and cheerful giggles guided everyone safely through the forest trees!

pages.title: The End ✨
pages.narrative: Thank you for joining our magical tale! Happy memories and laughter forever.
pages.narrative2: Until our next grand storybook adventure begins!
